description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayAgentChannel in the OpenClaw project. It verifies the behavior of the shouldDeliver method for various channels, tests the initialization of GatewayAgentChannel with raw string inputs, including normalization and fallback logic.

classes.name: GatewayAgentChannelTests
classes.description: A struct that contains test cases for the GatewayAgentChannel's delivery logic and initialization behavior.

methods.name: should deliver blocks web chat
methods.description: Tests that the webchat channel does not deliver blocks when shouldDeliver is called with true or false.

methods.name: should deliver allows last and provider channels
methods.description: Verifies that 'last', 'whatsapp', 'telegram', 'googlechat', and 'bluebubbles' channels are set to deliver for true, and 'last' is false for false.

methods.name: init raw normalizes and falls back to last
methods.description: Tests that initializing GatewayAgentChannel with various raw string inputs normalizes and defaults to 'last' when input is nil, empty, or unrecognized.
